items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is valid, the 100 µL volumes use the p300, and the labware is used correctly. Every measured check passed.
Each destination gets its own pick_up_tip and drop_tip around the aspirate and dispense. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all passed.
The protocol makes the single 100 µL transfer from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and then B1, in order. The end_state check passed and nothing extra was added.
The reservoir (slot 1) and plate (slot 2) are loaded with the required labels. The p20 and p300 are on the correct mounts with the right tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
p300 aspirates 100 µL from reservoir A1 and dispenses 100 µL each into plate A1 and B1. The end_state check shows [100, 100] and no other wells are touched.

judge.summary: The protocol simulated cleanly, and every measured check passed. It moves 100 µL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 with the p300, using a fresh tip for each destination and dropping every tip.
